title: Heim Waltz
overview:
Health, comfort, safety.

Heim Waltz proposes healthy homes that answer the new lifestyles of a new era.

This not-for-sale house information disc from Sekisui Chemical introduces its Heim Waltz homes. It is not a game: it offers two courses for exploring the house.

- Walk-through: stroll through the rooms and see every corner of the home
- Planning: browse floor plans for each floor and enjoy idea spaces suited to different lifestyles

健康、快適、安全。

ハイムワルツは、新しい時代の新しいライフスタイルにこたえる健康な住まいをご提案いたします。
